repos.summary_zh: 该项目是免费编程书籍的权威集合，涵盖多语言、多领域的开源学习资源，支持动态搜索和静态网站访问，由非营利组织 Free Ebook Foundation 维护，是全球最受欢迎的开源项目之一。
repos.summary_en: This repository aggregates freely available programming books across multiple languages and domains, featuring dynamic search and static site access. Maintained by the non-profit Free Ebook Foundation, it is one of GitHub's most popular open-source projects.

repos.description: :books: 免费的计算机编程类中文书籍，欢迎投稿
repos.summary_zh: 本项目是免费的中文编程书籍索引库，涵盖操作系统、Web开发、算法、大数据等语言无关和语言相关的计算机技术书籍，提供高质量的学习资源集合，支持社区投稿与更新，助力程序员技能提升。
repos.summary_en: This repository provides a curated collection of free Chinese programming books covering computer science fundamentals, web development, algorithms, and major programming languages, serving as a valuable learning resource for developers with community-driven contributions.

repos.description: 《动手学深度学习》：面向中文读者、能运行、可讨论。中英文版被70多个国家的500多所大学用于教学。
repos.summary_zh: 《动手学深度学习》是一本面向中文读者的开源深度学习教材，提供可运行代码与交互式学习体验，覆盖数学原理、算法实现与工程实践。该书被全球500多所大学采用，支持中英双语教学，强调批判性思维与动手能力，助力学习者成为具备实战能力的AI应用科学家。
repos.summary_en: Dive into Deep Learning is an open-source textbook designed for Chinese readers, offering executable code and interactive learning. It integrates mathematical theory, algorithmic implementation, and engineering practice, adopted by over 500 universities worldwide. The book emphasizes hands-on learning to cultivate AI application scientists with both theoretical depth and practical skills.

repos.description: Python资源大全中文版，包括：Web框架、网络爬虫、模板引擎、数据库、数据可视化、图片处理等，由「开源前哨」和「Python开发者」微信公号团队维护更新。
repos.summary_zh: jobbole/awesome-python-cn 是 Python 资源大全的中文镜像仓库，涵盖 Web 框架、网络爬虫、数据库、数据可视化、机器学习等全领域工具链。由开源社区维护，提供分类清晰的资源列表，助力开发者快速定位高质量 Python 生态组件。
repos.summary_en: jobbole/awesome-python-cn is the Chinese mirror of Python's comprehensive resource repository, covering tools across Web frameworks, web scraping, databases, data visualization, machine learning, and more. Maintained by open-source communities, it offers a well-organized catalog of high-quality Python ecosystem components for developers.

repos.description: 经典编程书籍大全，涵盖：计算机系统与网络、系统架构、算法与数据结构、前端开发、后端开发、移动开发、数据库、测试、项目与团队、程序员职业修炼、求职面试等
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库收录100+经典编程书籍，全面覆盖计算机系统与网络、算法与数据结构、前后端开发、数据库、测试、职业修炼等核心领域，精选伯乐在线及社区广泛推荐的权威技术读物，是程序员系统提升技能的理想资源库。
repos.summary_en: This repository curates 100+ essential programming books across core domains including computer systems, algorithms, web/mobile development, databases, testing, and career growth. It aggregates highly recommended technical reads from Jobbole and the developer community, serving as a comprehensive learning resource for programmers.

repos.summary_zh: FMHY 是一个聚合海量免费资源的互联网平台，涵盖软件、工具、学习资料等，提供结构化索引与社区推荐。项目通过 Wiki 维护内容，支持 Markdown/JSON API 备份，强调去中心化存储与社区协作，所有文件均托管于第三方，确保内容自由开放。
repos.summary_en: FMHY is the largest internet platform curating free resources like software, tools, and learning materials, offering structured indexes and community recommendations. It maintains content via a Wiki, supports Markdown/JSON API backups, emphasizes decentralized storage, and operates without hosting files, ensuring open and free access.

repos.summary_zh: 《Python Cookbook》3rd Edition 中文翻译项目，由David Beazley原著，完整覆盖Python 3.6特性，提供100+实用代码示例，涵盖数据结构、并发编程、网络开发等核心领域，是中文开发者掌握Python 3的权威实践指南。
repos.summary_en: This is the Chinese translation of 'Python Cookbook' 3rd Edition by David Beazley, featuring 100+ practical Python 3.6 code examples across core domains like data structures, concurrency, and network programming, serving as an authoritative hands-on guide for Chinese developers mastering Python 3.

repos.description: 免费无广告的追剧资源指南，人工精选资源、每天检测资源有效性。收录在线影视、影视APP、网盘搜索、磁力BT、字幕、TVBox / 影视仓空壳软件/配置地址、IPTV直播源、会员拼团、影视相关开源项目。开源，社区共同维护。
repos.summary_zh: 这是一款免费无广告的追剧资源聚合指南，人工精选并每日自动检测资源有效性。收录在线影视、影视APP、网盘搜索、磁力BT、字幕、TVBox配置、IPTV直播源等117个资源，完全开源，支持社区共同维护与贡献。
repos.summary_en: A free, ad-free curated guide for streaming resources with manual selection and daily automated validation. Covers online streaming, TV apps, cloud search, torrent/磁力 links, subtitles, TVBox configurations, and IPTV sources—117 resources total, fully open-source and community-maintained.

repos.description: 免费无广告的追剧资源指南，人工精选资源、每天检测资源有效性。收录在线影视、影视APP、网盘搜索、磁力BT、字幕、TVBox / 影视仓空壳软件/配置地址、IPTV直播源、会员拼团、影视相关开源项目。开源，社区共同维护。
repos.summary_zh: Awesome Zhuiju Free 是一个开源、免费且无广告的追剧资源导航项目。它通过人工精选与每日自动化检测，收录了涵盖在线影视、影视APP、网盘搜索、磁力BT、TVBox配置及IPTV直播源等80余个高质量资源。项目采用社区共同维护模式，旨在为用户提供纯净、有效且持续更新的影视观看解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Awesome Zhuiju Free is an open-source, ad-free resource guide for tracking dramas and movies. Combining manual curation with daily automated availability checks, it aggregates over 80 high-quality resources including online streaming, apps, cloud storage searches, magnet links, TVBox configurations, and IPTV sources. Maintained by the community, it aims to provide a pure, reliable, and continuously updated viewing solution.

repos.description: 🧑‍🚀 全世界最好的LLM资料总结（多模态生成、Agent、辅助编程、AI审稿、数据处理、模型训练、模型推理、o1 模型、MCP、小语言模型、视觉语言模型） | Summary of the world's best LLM resources.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库是全网最全面的大语言模型（LLM）资源汇总，涵盖多模态生成、Agent、辅助编程、AI审稿、数据处理、模型训练与推理等全链路技术方向，持续更新维护，为研究者与开发者提供权威的一站式学习与实践指南。
repos.summary_en: This repository is the most comprehensive collection of LLM resources globally, covering multimodal generation, agents, code assistance, AI review, data processing, model training and inference, and more. It serves as an authoritative one-stop guide for researchers and developers, continuously updated.

repos.description: Featuring powerful AI capabilities and supporting various e-book formats, it makes reading smarter and more focused.
repos.summary_zh: Anx Reader 是一款专为书迷打造的智能电子书阅读器，集成强大 AI 功能，支持 EPUB、MOBI、AZW3、FB2、TXT、PDF 等多种格式。提供 AI 摘要、翻译、思维导图生成、多端同步、自定义排版、语音朗读及阅读统计等深度功能，致力于提升阅读效率与沉浸体验。
repos.summary_en: Anx Reader is an AI-powered e-book reader designed for book lovers, supporting multiple formats like EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, FB2, TXT, and PDF. It features AI summaries, translation, mind mapping, cross-platform sync, customizable typography, TTS, and reading analytics to enhance focus and reading pleasure.

repos.description: :100: 2026年系统架构设计师（软考高级）备考资料。
repos.summary_zh: 该项目为2026年软考高级系统架构设计师备考资料库，涵盖历年真题、模拟卷、精讲视频及论文范文，支持免费与付费资源更新。提供多平台刷题工具（网页/小程序/App），并持续优化教程与考纲解析，助力考生高效通过考试。
repos.summary_en: This repository provides comprehensive study materials for the 2026 System Architect Designer exam (a senior-level soft certification). It includes past papers, mock tests, video courses, and essay templates. Free and paid resources are updated regularly, with multi-platform practice tools (web, WeChat mini-program, mobile app) and optimized tutorials to help candidates pass efficiently.

repos.description: ezBookkeeping is an open source, powerful, self-hosted personal finance app that is easy to use.
repos.summary_zh: ezBookkeeping 是一款轻量级自托管个人财务管理应用，支持 Docker 快速部署，具备用户友好的界面和强大的记账功能。支持多语言、多币种、AI 收据识别、数据导入导出（CSV/OFX/QFX 等），并提供图表分析、地理位置标记、双因素认证等高级特性，适用于 Raspberry Pi、NAS 等低资源设备。
repos.summary_en: ezBookkeeping is a lightweight, self-hosted personal finance app with a user-friendly interface and powerful bookkeeping features. It supports Docker deployment, multi-language/currency, AI receipt recognition, data import/export (CSV/OFX/QFX), chart analytics, location tagging, and 2FA, optimized for low-resource devices like Raspberry Pi and NAS.

repos.summary_zh: 12306ForMac 是一款非官方的 Mac 版 12306 火车票订票助手，支持自动捡票与下单功能。基于 Swift 开发，依赖 Carthage 管理 CocoaPods 依赖，兼容 OS X 10.11 及以上系统。项目采用 Alamofire、PromiseKit 等主流框架，提供图形化界面替代官方网页购票，适用于 macOS 用户便捷购票。
repos.summary_en: 12306ForMac is an unofficial macOS client for 12306 railway ticket booking, supporting auto-search and purchasing. Built with Swift 3.2 and Xcode 9.0, it uses Carthage for dependency management and integrates Alamofire, PromiseKit, and FMDB. Designed for OS X 10.11+, it offers a native GUI alternative to the official web interface for convenient ticket booking.

repos.description: 如果有人让你推荐 Python 技术书，请让他看这个列表
repos.summary_zh: 本项目为 Python 开发者精心整理的权威技术书籍推荐列表，涵盖入门到进阶全阶段，包含《Head First Python》《集体智慧编程》《利用 Python 进行数据分析》等经典著作，结合社区投票与豆瓣评分，提供高质量学习资源导航。
repos.summary_en: This repo curates a comprehensive list of authoritative Python technical books from beginner to advanced levels, featuring classics like 'Head First Python', 'Programming Collective Intelligence', and 'Python for Data Analysis', backed by community votes and Douban ratings for reliable learning guidance.

repos.description: 一句话生成大师级海报、书籍封面、专辑封面和各类设计作品。无需懂PS、配色或艺术史，AI自动选择最佳风格（基于20位传奇海报设计师）。支持电影海报、读书笔记、公众号封面、小红书配图等。默认9:16竖版，完美适配社交媒体。包含AI提示词优化、风格对比、图生图转换功能。触发词："Mondo风格"、"书籍封
repos.summary_zh: 乔木Mondo海报设计是一款AI驱动的设计工具，用户只需一句话描述需求，即可自动生成专业级海报、书籍封面、专辑封面等设计作品。基于20位传奇设计师风格库，支持多场景适配（公众号、小红书、电影海报等），内置AI提示词优化与风格对比功能，无需设计基础即可产出大师级作品。
repos.summary_en: Qiaomu Mondo Poster Design is an AI-powered tool that generates professional posters, book covers, and album art from a single sentence. It leverages styles from 20 legendary designers, supports multiple social media formats (WeChat, Xiaohongshu), and includes AI prompt optimization and style comparison features, enabling anyone to create master-level designs without design skills.

repos.summary_zh: 本项目将《数理化自学丛书》17册扫描PDF重建为语义化Markdown与可复现EPUB3电子书，保留全部4,875幅插图与88,653个MathML公式。提供完整构建工具链、来源审计与隐私门禁，适用于文献保存、校勘与个人研究场景。
repos.summary_en: Rebuilds the 17-volume Self-Study Series of Math, Physics & Chemistry from scanned PDFs into semantic Markdown and reproducible EPUB3 ebooks, preserving 4,875 illustrations and 88,653 MathML formulas. Provides full build toolchain, provenance auditing, and privacy gates for archival and research use.

repos.summary_zh: 该项目通过 ISBN 空间可视化技术，将全球图书数据映射为二维空间，支持按出版社、稀有度等维度进行交互式探索。基于预处理的 ISBN 前缀数据和图书馆馆藏信息，生成高分辨率 PNG 瓦片数据集，适用于大规模图书数据的直观分析与展示。
repos.summary_en: This project visualizes the global book catalog by mapping ISBNs into a 2D space, enabling interactive exploration by publisher, rarity, and other dimensions. It uses preprocessed ISBN prefix data and library holdings to generate high-resolution PNG tile datasets for intuitive analysis and visualization of massive book collections.

repos.description: 用 LLM 和 jina reader 生成的总结
repos.summary_zh: 该项目利用 LLM 和 jina reader 自动读取 bookmark-collection 中的网页书签内容，生成结构化摘要。通过 GitHub Action 实现自动化处理，支持按月归档，适用于个人知识管理和内容聚合，核心亮点在于结合 AI 总结与网页内容提取技术。
repos.summary_en: This project uses LLM and jina reader to automatically extract and summarize web content from bookmarks in bookmark-collection. Integrated with GitHub Actions for automation, it supports monthly archiving and enables personal knowledge management through AI-powered content aggregation and summarization.

repos.description: hexo插件 - 七牛资源同步. 可以在本地存放好静态资源（图片、JS、CSS），然后在md文章中直接使用标签引用，在发布时会自动将静态资源上传到你的七牛空间中，并在hexo生成的静态页面中自动引用这些静态资源在千牛的url。
repos.summary_zh: hexo-qiniu-sync 是一个 Hexo 插件，用于自动将本地静态资源（如图片、JS、CSS）同步至七牛云存储，并在生成的静态页面中自动替换为七牛外链 URL。支持离线预览、增量同步、图片处理（缩略图/水印）等功能，简化博客资源管理流程。
repos.summary_en: hexo-qiniu-sync is a Hexo plugin that automatically syncs local static resources (images, JS, CSS) to Qiniu Cloud Storage and replaces references in generated pages with Qiniu CDN URLs. It supports offline preview, incremental sync, image processing (thumbnails/watermarks), and simplifies blog asset management.
